label: prop:b1-soft-sharpness-theorem
title: Soft sharpness of the depth correspondence is theorem-level — via Borel + polylog non-vanishing
html:
Let K be a Bring-embeddable knot with shape parameter z_K \in \overline{\mathbb{Q}}^\times \setminus \{0, 1\} and let F = \mathbb{Q}(z_K). For every n \geq 2:

  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\bigl(\mathrm{Li}_n^q(z_K)\bigr) \;\not\equiv\; 0 \pmod{\mathcal{P}_{n-1}}.

This is the soft sharpness half of the depth correspondence conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence. The depth-n image \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(G^{(n)}\rvert_F) is non-trivial in \mathcal{P}_n / \mathcal{P}_{n-1}. It requires no part of Goncharov's or Beilinson's conjectures.
heading: Proposition
